body:
# mcpx(plugin): the dogfood `.opencode/plugin` copy has drifted from `pkgs/mcpx` again — `daemon.ts` is pre-#3490 and `biome.json` is missing

## Evidence (verified this run, main `d222177982`)

The sync guard in `.github/workflows/mcpx.yml` (plugin-sync job, lines 99–100; repeated in the test job, lines 130–131) is an exact byte comparison:

```
diff -r pkgs/mcpx/plugin/opencode/mcpx .opencode/plugin/mcpx
diff pkgs/mcpx/plugin/opencode/mcpx-session.ts .opencode/plugin/mcpx-session.ts
```

Run by hand on the laptop primary at `d222177982`, the first diff fails (rc=1) with exactly three drift paths:

```
Only in pkgs/mcpx/plugin/opencode/mcpx: biome.json
Files pkgs/mcpx/plugin/opencode/mcpx/daemon.test.ts and .opencode/plugin/mcpx/daemon.test.ts differ
Files pkgs/mcpx/plugin/opencode/mcpx/daemon.ts and .opencode/plugin/mcpx/daemon.ts differ
```

(`mcpx-session.ts` is in sync; the other five files in the directory are identical.)

What the drift means, concretely:

- `daemon.ts`: the `.opencode` copy is the pre-#3490 `goDurationMs` — its unit table lacks the Greek-mu micro sign (U+03BC) and its grammar rejects Go-valid dot fractions (`.5s`, `1.s`), so those duration spellings silently fall back to the default cooldown; its saturation cap is `9_223_372_036_854.776` where the fixed source has `.775`. `pkgs/mcpx/plugin/opencode/mcpx/daemon.ts` was last fixed by `04f564f211` (#3490); the `.opencode` copy was never updated after it.
- `daemon.test.ts`: the `.opencode` copy lacks the #3490 Go-parity test block (and carries the old `.776` expectation), so even the copied tests would not catch the stale parser.
- `biome.json`: added to the pkgs copy by the #5151 pinned plugin lint/type-check work (`6e50a61760`); absent from the dogfood copy, so the copy the repo's own OpenCode loads is not the linted configuration.

The `.opencode/plugin` copy is the one this repo's own OpenCode sessions actually load (mcpx.yml:121: "The repo dogfoods the plugin"). The fleet's own tooling is therefore running the stale duration parser today.

## Why the guard did not catch it

The guard lives only in `mcpx.yml` (grep over `.github/workflows/*.yml`, `flake.nix`, `justfile`: the two mcpx.yml sites are the only ones), and that workflow currently has no `push`/`pull_request` triggers and is `disabled_manually` — filed separately as the companion CI issue (mcpx.yml trigger/enablement loss). This is the third instance of the same class: #314 (ops.gen.ts 9 ops behind, no guard), #2795 (drifted again; guard push-only). Each sync without a running guard has re-drifted.

## Why it matters

- A declared byte-identity contract is silently false on main; anyone reading `.opencode/plugin` sees code that is not the plugin's current behavior.
- The stale copy is live, not archival: it is the plugin loaded by OpenCode sessions working in this repo.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `diff -r pkgs/mcpx/plugin/opencode/mcpx .opencode/plugin/mcpx` exits 0 on main (biome.json present; daemon.ts and daemon.test.ts at the pkgs versions).
- [ ] `diff pkgs/mcpx/plugin/opencode/mcpx-session.ts .opencode/plugin/mcpx-session.ts` still exits 0.
- [ ] The synced copy's plugin tests pass (the #3490 parity block in daemon.test.ts green against the synced daemon.ts).
- [ ] No change to `pkgs/mcpx/plugin/**` itself — the pkgs tree is the source of truth.
